title: narcissus × primulinus var. bifrons
intro: Narcissus × primulinus var. bifrons, commonly known as the split-leaved narcissus or split leaf daffodil, is a hybrid plant that results from the cross between Narcissus pseudonarcissus and Narcissus cantabricus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus × primulinus var. bifrons include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve anxiety and depression, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
